about.heading: A bit about me
bio: I'm a full stack developer based in Cuiabá, Brazil. I work with React, Next.js and Vue on the front end, Node.js, Nest.js, Adonis.js and Laravel on the back end, with PostgreSQL and MongoDB behind them.

I started out in technical support in 2022 — handling users, diagnosing software and network failures, setting up systems. That's what pulled me into development: at HPAR I was promoted to Programming Assistant, maintaining and building websites and apps, testing new software and writing technical documentation.

I hold a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from UNIVAG and I'm currently taking a graduate course in Full Stack Web Development. Years on the support side taught me to write code around the person on the other side of the screen.
